title: The MS Unidirectional Current as a Generalization of the ABC Absorption Current
summary: For a free scalar particle in one spatial dimension, in a single-pass half-line geometry, we compare the absorbing Robin boundary condition with the generalized Marchewka--Schuss (MS) unidirectional-current family. Robin absorption is characterized by a single parameter $κ>0$: once $κ$ is specified, its momentum-dependent absorption profile is fixed. In the generalized MS construction, by contrast, the detector response is described by a spectral function $λ(k)$, subject to the positivity and subnormalization conditions of the detection law.
